title: Settings
intro: Your AI keys, caption defaults and account.

signInRequired.title: Sign In Required
signInRequired.body: You need to sign in to access your settings

captions.title: Caption defaults
captions.description: Applied to every new generation. You can still change them per video.
captions.sample: Your subtitle will look like this

deleteAccount.title: Danger zone
deleteAccount.label: Delete account
deleteAccount.hint: Permanently delete your account, generations, clips and uploaded fonts.
deleteAccount.dialogBody: This permanently deletes your account, all generations and clips, and your uploaded fonts. This can't be undone.

fonts.unchecked: Language coverage could not be checked. Preview your captions to confirm the characters display correctly.
fonts.fallback: Missing characters use a fallback font and may look different. Coverage is checked from this font file; preview captions for uncommon characters.

ai.title: AI and transcription
ai.description: Claude reads the transcript, picks the moments and writes hook titles. AssemblyAI transcribes the video.
ai.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change these keys.
ai.setup1: Create an API key in the Anthropic Console:
ai.setup2: Paste it below and test the connection.
ai.setup3: Pick a model and save. New generations use Claude right away.
ai.keyPlaceholder: Paste a key that starts with sk-ant-
ai.keyReplacePlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace the saved one
ai.testFailed: The test could not run. Check that the server is reachable.
ai.modelHint: The model ID sent to the Anthropic API. After a successful test, this list shows every model your key can use.
ai.preferSaved: Use these saved values instead of the server environment
ai.envNote: The server environment also sets {keys}, and it wins unless this is ticked.
ai.costNote: Claude and AssemblyAI usage is billed to your own accounts. Testing the Claude connection is free.
ai.assemblyKeyHint: Transcribes each video with word timings for the captions. Create a key in your AssemblyAI dashboard at

youtube.title: YouTube auto-post
youtube.description: Claude writes a title, description, tags and hashtags for every finished clip, and it posts to your own channel as a Short with the visibility you choose below.
youtube.setupHint: Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET in the server environment to turn this on. See docs/youtube.md in this repo for how to get them.
youtube.connectFailed: Could not start the connection. Please try again.
youtube.autoPostLabel: Publish every new clip to this channel as soon as it's ready
youtube.playlistHint: Each video's Shorts go into their own playlist, named after the source video.
youtube.playlistNeedsAccess: Playlists need one more permission from YouTube.
youtube.fullVideoHint: Adds "Full video:" and the source link to each description. YouTube links only, not uploads.
youtube.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
youtube.reauthRequired: Your YouTube connection needs to be renewed before clips can post again.
youtube.privateLock: YouTube made your uploads private. This happens until your API project passes YouTube's audit. Posting is paused until you resume it.
youtube.resumeFailed: Could not resume posting. Please try again.
youtube.disconnectFailed: Could not disconnect. Please try again.
youtube.disconnectBody: Clips that haven't posted yet are cancelled. This never removes videos already on YouTube.
youtube.policyIntro: Clipwright only uploads the clips you see here; it never reads anything else from your channel.
youtube.permissions: Manage access on your Google Account

errors.denied: You declined access, so YouTube auto-post was not connected.
errors.expired: That connection link expired. Please connect again.
errors.missing_scope: Both permissions are required to post clips; tick both and try again.
errors.no_channel: That Google account has no YouTube channel to post to.
errors.exchange_failed: Connecting to YouTube failed. Please try again.
errors.not_configured: YouTube auto-post is not configured on this server.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong connecting to YouTube. Please try again.
